_about: Cosmic horror: something vast and indifferent, and the cost of understanding it. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

presence: a pattern in the stars that only some can see
a sound under the floor of the world
a thing that lives in a language
a tide that comes in from somewhere other than the sea
a geometry that should not close
a colour that was not there yesterday
wants: nothing: it does not notice people at all
to be finished, and people are the last pieces
a way through, and the town is the door
to be fed something people value
first_sign: a neighbour repeats the same sentence
a stain that comes back after scrubbing
a letter arrives from someone long dead
the church bell rings one too many times
rule: it cannot act on what is not looked at
it follows anyone who says its name
salt slows it, nothing stops it
it can only take what is offered
it keeps every promise made near it
it cannot cross running water, yet
cost: the ones who understand start to forget their families
every answer leaves a mark on the skin
trust between the characters wears thin
the town turns against whoever asks
someone close changes, a little at a time
money and goods lose all meaning to the touched
refuge_fails: the locked room was never locked
the friend who shelters them is already part of it
the church is the centre of it
the records that would help have been rewritten

1: something small is wrong and nobody else minds
a thing goes missing that no one else remembers owning
an animal acts as if someone is standing behind a character
2: someone the party knows is touched by it
the wrongness has a shape now, and it is near
a safe place proves it is not
3: a character's own mind turns against them for a moment
the town begins to act as one
4: the truth is seen whole, and something must be given up to walk away
the choice: stop it or flee with what is left

cliches: it was all in their head
the old book of the dead
